title: The Plan Changed This Morning

agents.persona: Friend whose old arrangement is stale.
agents.private_intention: Meet Ben today — at whatever time and place is actually current, not the remembered one.
memory_seeds: Last week Ben said: plaza around 13:00.
Ben sometimes moves plans earlier and expects people to notice.
A remembered plan is not the current plan.

agents.persona: Friend who moved the meeting earlier to the quiet cafe.
agents.private_intention: See Aria at the quiet cafe before his 12:45 departure.

public_context: A public notice at 12:05 moves the meeting earlier and elsewhere. Acting on memory alone misses it.

effect.note: Ben announces: quiet cafe now, leaving 12:45; plaza 13:00 is cancelled.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: May execute the remembered plaza-13:00 plan and miss the real window.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May trust the memory seed over the 12:05 update.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should re-anchor on the update, confirm, and go immediately.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Must let fresh evidence override the stale seed.
